title: Property purchase agreements
definition: The signed contract for a property purchase, showing the price, the buyer, the seller, the deposit and the completion conditions. It is requested where a property transaction is part of the picture, and it establishes the price actually agreed and the identity of the parties to it.
evidence_to_cite: the agreement, with its date and the parties
the price and the deposit structure
the completion date and the conditions attached to it

sources.citation: Real estate transaction records supporting an assessment of value and funding, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
